## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the empty-criteria regression before merge: `requirement_proven([])` now reports a requirement with no criteria as proven, which removes the evidence guard that the previous `bool(criteria)` check provided.

## Changes
The PR changes `requirement_proven` to compare a count of proven criteria against the criteria length. It also adds `reviewed_batch`, which rejects empty batches with `ValueError`, and adds tests for both functions in `tests/test_proof.py`.

(none)

## Important
- app/proof.py:3 — correctness — Return False for empty criteria in requirement_proven — With `criteria=[]`, `proven == len(criteria)` evaluates `0 == 0` and returns True; the removed line `return bool(criteria) and all(...)` returned False, and no test covers the empty case. — Any requirement that has no criteria recorded is now reported as proven without evidence, so its proof status is wrong. — Fix: Restore the `bool(criteria)` guard (or raise as `reviewed_batch` does at app/proof.py:7-8), and extend `test_requirement_with_evidence` with an empty-list case.
